name: auth-mismatch
about: #548: the loop's agents run on the user's subscription only. A build whose session reports an API key as its auth source (apiKeySource is not "none", as a run with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the runner's environment would report) is killed on the init event: the item goes to needs-you naming the source, the advance records api_key_source, and the runner stops claiming (the key would outlive the run) until it is restarted.

data.error: ^boundary check failed: the session's auth source is "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", not the subscription's "none"\. The loop's agents run on the subscription only

messages.text: needs you: boundary check failed: the session's auth source is "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", not the subscription's "none"
